chunks: Surely your Lord in His wisdom will decide between them. He is all-mighty and all-knowing.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean when Allah says He will decide between people with His wisdom?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the inevitability of divine judgment (Hukm) where Allah resolves conflicts not merely by decree but through His perfect, all-encompassing wisdom. The attributes of Al-Aziz and Al-Alim serve as a reassurance to the faithful that despite worldly disputes, ultimate justice is guaranteed by the One who is both powerful enough to enforce it and knowledgeable enough to judge it with precision.
